component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.ui.operations
component.documentation:
The Automation operations and chains that a business app's buttons may run on this server: the deployment's allow-list (plan decision 3, on its recommendation).
An app's actions.json names an operation for each button that runs one. The app registry, at /nuxeo/agentic-ui-apps/, serves the file with only the actions whose operation is on this allow-list, each with only the parameters it gives the operation, and says in its diagnostics what it left out. The operation AgenticUi.RunAction runs such an action on one record, and checks the allow-list again first, with the user's permission on the record.
The allow-list is the deployment's, not an app's: it is read only from a file the server's administrators put in nxserver/config/, which the runtime deploys in its own context. A contribution from a bundle, a package's among them, is refused, and the log says so; the package pipeline refuses a package that contributes here too. With no contribution, nothing is allowed.
Not a control over Nuxeo's own Automation endpoint, which still runs any operation a user may run, through /nuxeo/api/v1/automation/, directly or through a dispatcher such as RunOperation, whatever REST binding the operation has. A chain meant only for a button begins with AgenticUi.RequireRunAction, which refuses every run but AgenticUi.RunAction's.

extension-point.name: allowList
extension-point.documentation:
One operation or chain per element, by its id.
payers-claims claims-adjusters Claim inReview
permission is the one the user needs on the record, besides Read: Write when left out. Each app, group, type and state, when there is one, narrows it: the apps whose buttons may run it, a group the user must be in, the record's type and its lifecycle state. Each param is a parameter an app's action may give the operation: its name; its type, string, boolean, long or double, a string at most maxLength characters, 1000 when left out, and at most 10000; where its value may come from, input for the action's form, literal for the app's file, or field: and a property of the stored record, any of them when left out; and whether it is required. An action that gives a parameter not listed here, from elsewhere, or without one required, is not served, and does not run. The platform's own AgenticUi operations, and those that run another operation, a script or as another user, such as RunOperation or Auth.LoginAs, are never allowed. An entry that fails a check is not registered, the log says why, and it takes an entry of the same id registered before it out with it. A later contribution with the same id replaces it whole, and enabled="false" removes it.
